title: Final Boss! Final Exam Review — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)

chapters.CHEM 3B: Organic midterm review and biochemistry final review

description: Practice for standardized multiple-choice chemistry finals in CHEM 3A (intro chem), 3B (organic and biochem), 1A (gen chem I) and 1B (gen chem II). Boss Battle timed practice exams (Practice style or Exam Day style with directions, bubble sheet and data sheet only), Topic Training with hints and step-by-step explanations, Weak Spots review of missed questions, Quick 10, and Blitz speed rounds. About 2,450 original questions, with an explanation for every wrong answer, a TI-36X Pro style practice calculator, matched ItsDrDan videos, a periodic table and data sheet, XP and badges. CHEM 3B has a separate Organic Midterm and Biochem Final. Add ?course=3A, 3B, 1A or 1B to open a course.
